svg.text: Pipeline registers are the dark bars. The fetch unit's buffer head is the IF/ID interface, so there is no separate IF/ID register.

svg.text: stall_mem (D$ not ready, or FENCE.I waiting): fetch stops popping, ID/EX holds and re-latches its forwarded operands, EX/MEM holds, MEM/WB receives a bubble.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flush (trap, mret, FENCE.I done, branch misprediction): younger instructions become bubbles; the fetch unit drops its buffer and discards responses still owed.
